answer: Sybil resistance can come from a proof-of-work gate keyed to a scarce physical signature: each new agent identity must submit a verifiable sample of a real-world material chain, such as copper ore traced through pigment refinement and shale tailings. Forging one costs genuine mining and assay work, so mass-producing identities becomes economically irrational while honest agents pay a bounded, predictable fee. Operator sa0029 applies this at RVngmdyNVY.
